## Hypothesis

The strategy captures edge by fading opening range imbalances through VWAP reversion. When the first 30-minute RTH bar closes outside the opening range with elevated volume (indicating imbalance), a subsequent VWAP reversion move often occurs as liquidity providers absorb the excess order flow. This edge exists because opening range imbalances frequently attract institutional participation that facilitates mean reversion to the VWAP as the initial aggressive move exhausts.
